STATUS: approved

- **OBSERVED:** Diff is within the authorized implementation paths; `docs/ROADMAP.md` is the declared manager-owned roadmap reference. No out-of-scope implementation or new dependency/module exists.
- **OBSERVED:** `providerSession` is a closed fresh/resume DTO on the existing provider boundary. Relay persists distinct builder/reviewer bindings, records every attempt before retry, resumes only same role/provider IDs, and blocks malformed, missing-completed, or mismatched native IDs.
- **OBSERVED:** Codex uses parent `exec --sandbox ... -C ... resume <id>` and extracts JSONL agent text; Claude forces stream JSON for managed calls, captures `session_id`, and uses `--resume`. Protocol events do not enter returned workflow artifacts.
- **OBSERVED:** Lifecycle/adapter/CLI tests cover restart, distinct same-provider role IDs, model/provider/new-slice behavior, stateless auxiliary roles, retry persistence, malformed state, and hermetic argv/output parsing.
- **OBSERVED:** `npm run typecheck` and `git diff --check` passed in this review.
- **BUILDER-EXECUTED (not independently reproduced):** full Jest suite reported 181/181 passing and build passing. My focused Jest rerun was blocked before test execution by the read-only sandbox’s `EPERM` creating Jest’s haste-map temp file; this is an environment limitation, not product evidence.
- **OBSERVED (recorded manager evidence):** native Codex and Claude probe artifacts show fresh/resumed same IDs and retained context; Codex records read-only sandbox and isolated cwd on both turns. I did not launch providers, preserving SPS-P02.

The direct relay implementation serves the VISION’s inspectable, file-backed session supervision without a global cache/service. New abstractions are earned by the existing Codex/Claude boundary and the two concrete builder/reviewer dispatch sites.
